desc:
🚧 BETA 🚧 ScootR is still in development, so expect bugs daily updates! Tell me what you think. Your feedback shapes the game.
[Suprise at 500 likes!! 👀] <3

🛴 Ride, trick and build your dream scooter in a giant redwood forest!

🌲 Drop in from the huge MEGA RAMP and fly over the gap
🌀 Tailwhips, inwards, flips, barspins, grinds, manuals and endless combos
🔧 Build your own scooter part by part: decks, bars, forks, wheels and grip
🏗️ MY PARK: build your own skatepark, invite friends and build it together
🌍 Community Parks: share your park and ride the best parks from other players
🌙 MIDNIGHT RUN: a real playable pinball machine with a leaderboard to top
🎮 Play on PC, mobile and console
🌐 Playable in 46 languages

Join the ScootX community with the 🌍 button in-game!

Made by a solo dev ❤️
